reservation.rule: while the I2C2_SCL edge is served, GND must NOT claim cells inside the band on F.Cu: the band is reserved for that edge. The reservation is a ROUTING-SIDE constraint (a cell the engine may not use for GND), NOT a board edit.

3_corrected_complete_construction_drawin.deliverable_of_the_rule: the I2C2_SCL route then uses the 3757-cell free component around the port exactly as the R1440 witness does (F.Cu/In5.Cu + two F<->In5 vias); no new copper is required for GND (it re-fills by the existing pour stages), and nothing is moved on the board.
3_corrected_complete_construction_drawin.per_corridor_conservation: CORRIDOR level: the reserved band is 23.4 mm2 of F.Cu and is withheld from GND only for the duration of serving one edge; the I2C2_SCL route needs ~0.35 mm2 of copper plus its clearance envelope inside that band. GND continuity is restored by the pour stages (pour_aware_unfill -> refill -> pour_islands_repair, island fail-closed). Frame headroom (R1394) is context only, NOT this item justification.
3_corrected_complete_construction_drawin.authority_for_the_move: L2 in-domain routing-side reservation under #K2-464 sec.2.6 (item A); executed through the chain own path; versioned addendum (_v3), no frozen source edited; no topology/interface/pin-map change (not L1).
3_corrected_complete_construction_drawin.ref_plane_continuity: unchanged from v2 and still decided: the band is sealed by GND alone, holds no pad of any net and no via within 0.4mm; the two crossing nets are F.Cu signals referencing the adjacent inner plane, not the F.Cu pour, so withholding GND F.Cu in the band creates no return-path transition for them. ZERO new stitching holes required.
